source_title: MEDKids Joints starter card (demonstration data, unreviewed)
educational_content: A joint is a place where two bones meet. Joints let the body bend, twist and move. Knees and elbows are hinge joints that bend like a door. Shoulders and hips are ball-and-socket joints that move in many directions. Muscles pull on bones to move them at the joints.
learning_objectives: A joint is where two bones meet.
Joints let the body bend, twist and move.
Muscles pull on bones to move them at the joints.
